summary: Probabilities come from the measured share of similar past hourly bars (same 24h trend and RSI bucket) that were higher 24 trading hours later. Most shares sit near 50 percent, so forecasts stay close to 0.50. The largest tilts are USDCAD up (65% of n=362), USDJPY and USDCHF up, and EURUSD down (39% of n=385). Estimates with n below 400 are shrunk toward 0.50.
